job.question: In the Q&A for an external audit RFP for a retirement system whose general ledger system is Microsoft Dynamics SL, what were the total contractual fees for the prior year (FY2021) audits?
job.expected_facts: $73,000 (Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System, RFP 515-22-300 Q&A).
job.acceptance: $73,000 for FY2021 audits suffices; issuer/RFP number optional.

reviews.reason: This is a Hawaii ERS private-equity consultant RFP, not the external-audit RFP Q&A. It does not state total contractual fees for FY2021 audits.
quotes: Employees’ Retirement System of the State of Hawaii Request for Proposals Private Equity Consultant Services RFP 2022-04
The ERS is soliciting proposals from qualified firms to provide private equity investment consulting services to the Employees’ Retirement System of the State of Hawaii.
